source.title: January 2026 cheques issued — Vendor Cheque Register Report
source.reportDateInterpretation: month/day/year consistent with explicit January31 range; timezone not established

scope.jurisdiction: Municipality of the County of Richmond, Nova Scotia
scope.dateBasis: explicit source Cheque Date range 1/1/2026 through1/31/2026

filterCoverage.selectionBasis: Exact manually reviewed source vendor-ID/label allowlist; no automatic future label classification
filterCoverage.excludedScope: All other labels including natural persons, source-redacted entries, uncertain/truncated businesses and sensitive or unreviewed payee contexts remain unpublished. Exclusion does not mean every excluded label is a natural person.

filteredAmountSummary.label: Straight sum of displayed organization-only register amounts
filteredAmountSummary.treatment: Sum of displayed face amounts; no deduction, netting or bank-settlement inference.

limitations: This is a conservative organization-only subset, not a complete vendor register, recipient ledger or view of all municipal spending. Source totals include excluded rows and are not presented as subset totals.

Issued/register entries do not establish cleared cheques, settled bank payments, accrued expense, delivered goods or services, or the ultimate beneficiary. Online register sections must not be described as physical paper cheques.
The source supplies a dollar symbol but no ISO currency code, tax treatment, accounting basis or invoice-level purpose. Currency remains unspecified.
Void status preserves only whether the source marks a row with its asterisk legend. Absence of a marker does not prove the entry was never voided, replaced or adjusted later.

Official vendor IDs and cheque numbers are source-system identifiers, not bank account numbers or verified business registration IDs. Chequebook labels distinguish source register sections, not private bank account credentials.
Corporate/public-body labels can be abbreviated or truncated. No spelling expansion, legal-entity resolution, name-only contract match or payment-to-decision join is inferred.
The same vendor may have multiple distinct dated cheque entries; these are not deduplicated or scored as anomalies.
Exact-decimal sums describe only displayed amounts and are not loss, overspending, procurement-compliance or value-for-money findings.

Natural-person, source-redacted, sensitive-context and unreviewed labels are not projected. No individual scoring, bank details, health information, contacts or hidden redactions are published or reconstructed.
Raw PDF, all-row private extraction, page images, HTML/headers, system-user metadata and request journals remain private; only the independently reviewed factual projection may be released.
